items.title: Game Design
items.description: I design **gameplay mechanics and levels** with a focus on clarity, pacing and player experience. I turn ideas into playable structures and refine them through testing and iteration.

items.title: Game Programming
items.description: I implement gameplay mechanics and systems using **C++, C# and Blueprints**, mainly in Unreal Engine and Unity. I enjoy solving technical problems and building reliable foundations for prototypes.

items.title: Project Management
items.description: I have organized tasks and coordinated work in team projects using **Scrum and sprint planning**, supported by Jira and GitHub. I understand how to apply this workflow to define clear goals, track progress and keep development visible to the whole team.

items.title: Team Collaboration
items.description: I have built prototypes with **multidisciplinary teams**, sharing ideas, communicating progress and adapting my work to project needs. I enjoy contributing, receiving feedback and helping the team move forward.
